properties.notes: 191 industries in the Vrishabhavathi Valley catchment (Red 31, Orange 60, Green 97, White 3). The 8.008 MLD is effluent generated, not river discharge, and is not added to any drain load.

properties.notes: 18 CETPs; reported discharges sum to 65,096 KLD (65.096 MLD). CAVEAT: most Tiruppur CETPs claim zero liquid discharge (ZLD), so the reported discharge figures sit uneasily with the ZLD claims — treat as reported capacity/discharge, not a verified river load. Not added to any drain load. Separately, 10 proposed CETPs (41 MLD total, Rs 1,647.48 crore) in Erode/Namakkal along Cauvery tributaries have DPRs sent to Govt of India (2022) and funding awaited — proposed only, not rows here.
